newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences gets $200 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences gets $200 mln contract.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp said Monday it has been awarded a portion of a contract that could be worth $200 million to the company over four years.
Computer Sciences said it is one of six vendors awarded strategic business process reengineering services contracts by the U.S. Department of Defense.

CSC will provide a broad range of consulting and reengineering services in support of the Office of Assistant Secretary of Defense for Command, Control, Communications and Intelligence, other Defense Department organizations, the military departments and federal agencies.
